hero.title: The Boroughs
hero.about: An eight-episode supernatural sci-fi/horror series executive-produced by the Duffer Brothers (Stranger Things), created by Jeffrey Addiss and Will Matthews. In a sun-baked retirement community, an unlikely band of residents — played by Alfred Molina, Geena Davis, Bill Pullman, Alfre Woodard, Clarke Peters, Denis O'Hare and Jena Malone — bands together against an otherworldly threat. All eight episodes are on Netflix.
hero.why: You pinned this to your watchlist, and it's a direct multi-signal hit: sci-fi is your #1 genre, stacked here with supernatural horror, a heavyweight ensemble and Stranger Things pedigree — the Foundation / Severance prestige-sci-fi shelf. Rotten Tomatoes sits at 94%, and it lands as a full-season binge so there's no weekly wait. Tonight's marquee pick — rate it 1-5 stars with 2-3 tags when you're done.
